content: Tauyemidiwo yadi velau
Ama geluwo nuwanuwamai ebeha amhanapui hava Yaubada yana atemuyamuya ipapaihowaine tauyemidiwo yadi boda Masedoniya ainai.
Hiya vitai holanaena hilaulau neta towoi mwala'ina hive'ave'alo ta bwagana hiwewelohe na yadi yaliyaya imwala'i alili ta ainaena yadi velau idi'wa alili.
Mata yawalo mahalavaedi alimiyai neta velau ana mwala'i hava howahowadi mata himwaumwauwi neta himwauwi. Na hinage hava nigele howahowadi na himwauwi mata himwaumwau di'wa. Hibom yadi talam
alimaiyai hi'awanoi hamahamadudu ebeha Yaubada ana tauve'ahihiwo Yudeya vehabadi yadi tupwa hipaihowai hagu ainaena.
Yama nuwatuwu mata velau a'ava himwauwi na hesi hivelau di'wa wuwuna himoheuyoidi Yaubada ainai na mulitai atedi hitalamwedi alimaiyai.
Ainaena Taito bada velau ana vai ivetuwuni gamwagamwanimiyai eeta a'awanoiyei ebeha ive'ovidi.
Na ginauli dova yemidi yo aubabada yo hanapu yo vehaguhagu nuwalelena yo yami velau vehabamai aidiyai ammahuli alili. Eeta nuwanuwamai ebeha teina hinage velaune paihowana ainai ammahuli moiha.
Teina yawalowaloweine nigele dova loina na ebeha tomowa tupwadi yadi vehaguhagu nuwalelena ya'abiye mahalava ta ainaena na yami velau moihana yalautowoi.
Yada Bada Yeisu Besinana yana ve'i'ila bada amhanapuiya'o. Bwagana iya imahuli alili na hesi iveweweloheuyowei omiu vehabamiu ta ebe yana veweweloheyena iyemahuligomiu.

Na yagu nuwanuwatuwu teina dova. Bolimai tuluhadai haugana velau amvetuwuni inamwanamwa ta teina haugane amve'ovidi. Wuwuna omiu velau ana taupaihowao mugamugaimiu yo hinage omiu tomowa mugamugaimiu velau amyaliyayai.
Mwalona velaune amyaliyayai na yami yaliyayane iyemala moiha ta teina haugane hava howahowamiu yami tobwatobwao aidiyena paihowane amve'ovi.
Ebe velau tayaliyayai mata yada velaune Yaubada vehabana iyaliyaya. Yaubada nuwanuwana hava alidai imiyamiyane tamohei na hava nigele alidai iyamiyamiya nigele nuwanuwana.

Teina nigele yawalo ebeha tomowa tupwadi vitai hi'avala vehulu na omiu am'avalai. Na hesi nuwanuwamai neta maudoimiune amtoyatoyawa. Wuwuna hiya adi vahali holanai ta ebeha omiu yami mahuliyena amhaguidi. Eeta omiu mata ami vahali holanai yadi mahuliyena hihaguigomiu. Teina dova mata ampaihowauyoigomiu ta maudoimiu amtoyatoyawa.
Dova Yaubada yana Buki holanai hilele hiwalo, ‘Yaiya tomowa itano'ahai mwala'ina nigele ana tupwa mwala'ina. Na yaiya tomowa nigele iyatano'ahai moiha nigele iya'abiye ahubali.’
Taito ma'ana geluwo yadi lau Kolinita
Yaubada ainai ya'awa yauwedo wuwuna iya ipaihowai ta Taito yana nuwalelene alimiyai dova yau.
Moiha yama awanoi ainai italam na hesi ami hagu ainai inuwalele moiha ta ibom yana nuwatuwuwena itowolo ta ilalaowa alimiyai.
Taito na tahida teya avetamaledi ta hilalaowa. Wasa namwanamwana guguyana ainai tahida teina ilau'alili ta teina ainaena tauyemidi yadi boda maudoidi hive'ahihiyei mwala'ina.
Teina tahidane tauyemidiwo yadi boda hivesinuwai ta iya mata ihaguigai ta velaune alawei Yudeya. Ainaena Bada a'awa wasawasaei na mata tomowa hihanapui neta nuwanuwamai tauyemidiwo ahaguidi.
Teina velau mwala'ina yaiyadiwo a'ita'ita avivini ebeha ahibahiba ili'ilimani ta tomowa havena hivetavetalapili neta vehabana tahida teina alalauvaine.
Eeta yama venuwa ebeha yama mumuga hinamwanamwa nigele ebeha Yaubada mehenai ibom na tomowa hinage mehediyai.

Hinage tahida teya avetamalei ta teina tomowaone ivetonugaedi ta baidanao hilalaowa. Hauga bagibagilina alautowoi ginauli vagadi yo vagadi aidiyena ta alolobaine iya tautalam. Na teina haugane iya tautalam moihana vehabamiu wuwuna alimiyai iyemidi.

Na Taito iya yagu taliyataupaihowa ta ami hagu vehabana iya baidagu apaipaihowa. Na tahidao bwau Taito baidanao hilalaowa neta hiya tauyemidiwo yadi bodao vehabadi hitowotowolo yo hinage Besinana yana vewasawasa hi'abiye mwala'i.
Eeta yami velau amve'itaedi aidiyai ta tauyemidiwo yadi boda maudoidi mata hi'ita lobai ta yama nuwahaehae iyemala moiha.
